journeys.title: Korean Foundations
journeys.description: Core sentence patterns, everyday vocabulary, and the grammar that holds Korean sentences together. Learn each word when you need it, then keep using it.

journeys.title: Everyday Conversations
journeys.description: Short dialogues for greetings, ordering food, making plans, and getting around, built on the patterns from Korean Foundations.

modules.title: Verb Tenses in Everyday Sentences
modules.description: Say what you do, did, will do, and are doing right now, using casual verb endings and the particles that appear naturally along the way.
introduction: Korean places the main verb at the end of the sentence and often uses particles to show the roles of words.
We will learn everyday vocabulary as it becomes necessary, while practicing present, past, future, and progressive forms in short sentences.

modules.title: Questions and Negation
modules.description: Ask yes/no and question-word questions, and say what you don't or can't do with 안 and 못.

modules.title: Particles and Sentence Building
modules.description: Go deeper into 은/는 versus 이/가, add 도, 와/과, 에게, and build longer sentences.

modules.title: Polite Speech and Honorifics
modules.description: Turn casual sentences into polite -요 sentences and learn when each register is appropriate.
